The platform

Everything your scene needs, in one station.

Discovery, live radio, community rooms, and the culture around the music — built as one place instead of four separate apps.

Discover

Curated crates, not cold algorithms. New drops surfaced by real DJs and diggers, sorted by mood, era, or city.

Live sessions

Tune into 24/7 live radio, guest DJ takeovers, and listening parties — chat with the room while the needle drops.

Community rooms

Genre-based rooms for house heads, boom-bap purists, and everyone between. Voice, chat, and shared queues.

Culture drops

Limited vinyl reissues, artist collabs, and merch drops — first access for members, restocks never guaranteed.

Creator tools

Upload sets, track plays and fans, and sell your own drops directly to the people already listening.

Events & meetups

Local listening parties, record fair meetups, and festival crews — find your people off the platform too.

Getting started

Three steps to your first session.

01

Build your profile

Pick the genres, eras, and cities that shape your taste. We use it to seed your first crates — not to sell it.

02

Tune in & drop in

Join the 24/7 stream, hop into a room mid-conversation, or catch a scheduled guest set.

03

Build your crate

Save what hits, follow the diggers with your taste, and turn a playlist into a scene.

Questions

Before you press play.

Yes — the Free tier gets you 24/7 radio, two community rooms, and a weekly discovery crate, no credit card required.

Anytime, from your account settings — no phone calls or retention mazes. You'll keep access through the end of your billing period.

Human DJs and diggers curate each week's crate, then we shape it around the genres and cities you follow — never a black-box algorithm alone.

All Access members get creator tools to upload sets, see play stats, and list culture drops directly to the community.

You can export your crates and listening history any time. Deleting your account removes your data within 30 days.

Your next favorite song is one scroll away.

No card. No algorithm guessing your taste for you.

Orders received.

Live on this device only — there's no backend, so an order placed at checkout shows up here instantly when it's placed in this same browser. Every order starts at Payment not received and isn't confirmed until you've checked the buyer's UTR/reference against what actually came in. Click the status pill to step it forward: Payment not received → Payment received → Dispatched → Completed.
